title: aiBytes tag list
description: content/tags.json - the fixed vocabulary the curate step tags from and the tag filter renders. Hand-maintained, not generated. It lives in content/ rather than in the pipeline so the list can grow without a deploy; cutting or renaming a tag is the expensive direction, because it re-tags history.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change. Adding a tag or a group is not breaking.

groups.description: In the order the multi-select dropdown shows them.

name.description: The display name, and the exact string an edition item carries in its tags array. Unique across every group - a tag in two groups would break the filter.

slug.description: The URL form, as in ?t=agents,open-source. Stored rather than derived so the app and the extension cannot disagree on what 'Voice / Speech' slugs to - shareable URLs are part of the contract. Unique across every group.
